title: Investigating the EELS Signal Produced from Einsteinium-254
content: The study of fundamental chemical properties of transuranics remains a significant challenge due to the complexities associated with their production, purification, and handling. Their radioactive nature necessitates strict administrative and scientific controls be put in place to prevent misuse. While these controls are essential for nuclear stewardship and safe research practices, they impose limitations on sample preparation methods, often requiring simple and disposable techniques that restrict the scope of possible experiments.
